Description: Feed identifiers to subscribe to. Each entry matches the `symbol` field of `OraclePrice`, which equals `EventOraclePriceUpdate.id`. The format depends on the oracle type: - Coinbase:             asset key (e.g. "BTC") - Pyth:                 price feed ID hex hash - Stork:                asset symbol (e.g. "BTCUSD") - ChainlinkDataStreams:  feed ID hex string (e.g. "0x00034a45...") - PriceFeed:            compound "base/quote" (e.g. "BTC/USDT") - Provider:             compound "provider/symbol" (e.g. "acme/BTC") - PythPro:              decimal string of the uint32 feed ID (e.g. "12345") - SedaFast:             hex(keccak256(execProgramIdBytes || keccak256(execInputsBytes))) Use ["*"] to subscribe to all oracle price updates.
